attribution.localizedCause: The preload observer assumed nc_sgd_opt_set_all interposition would see LibNC internal registration, but those internal calls bypassed symbol preemption. The later executable-to-libnc nc_save_param_opt calls do cross the preload boundary and carry each NCParam name plus optimizer pointer.

decision.rationale: Add only observation-time name binding at nc_save_param_opt in a new source-bound q2 hook and rerun.

hypothesis.rationale: The fixture repeat and post-update predicates were not reached; the abort was an observer naming defect before any optimizer operation.

retiredDimensions: Gradient naming via nc_sgd_opt_set_all preload interposition alone.
transferableLessons: In q2, populate the observer name map by interposing nc_save_param_opt during the pre-update optimizer export, then delegate unchanged; preserve every scientific predicate and teacher operation.
uncertainties: Gradient population, post-update capture, repeat identity, and final scratch size remain untested.

reasons: The run reached the frozen boundary and wrote complete pre-update parameter, optimizer, batch, and recurrent state, then the observer aborted before the first gradient payload because internal LibNC parameter registration did not populate the preload hook name map.
